record.name: solar-solaredge-tracking-read
record.description: Show the accepted SolarEdge tracking: which PDF inverter and string input each panel was labelled with, the PDF and report it came from, and whether those panels still match the drawing. Labels only; no electrical design.

section.description: reference_changes lists missing frames, missing panels, moved panels with saved and current frame references, and new framed panels. saved_assignment_changes compares accepted tracking in two explicit versions of the same project drawing and returns each report's download reference. saved_frame_history shows frame changes across three explicitly selected, ordered project drawing versions, including panels that moved twice or returned to their original frame. optimizer_assignment_changes compares saved electrical string membership with a complete current report by shared panel identity. optimizers pages explicit report measurement rows, including partial observations. When an optimizer measurement summary includes optimizer_rows, use optimizers for details and strings for available optimizer_count values.

compare_to_version_id.description: Baseline saved version UUID for saved_assignment_changes or saved_frame_history. The version in the request URL is the final version.

intermediate_version_id.description: Intermediate saved version UUID for saved_frame_history. Choose a version between the baseline and final versions.
